<!-- DVL-PL-FORM:START -->
<style>
  .hs_cos_wrapper_type_form,
  .hs-form-private,
  .hbspt-form {
    max-width: 560px !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    display: block !important;
    padding-top: 50px !important;
    padding-bottom: 50px !important;
  }
  .hs-form label {
    color: #012638 !important; font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: .04em !important; text-transform: uppercase !important;
    margin-bottom: 6px !important; display: block !important; text-align: left !important;
  }
  .hs-form fieldset { max-width: 100% !important; }
  .hs-form input[type="text"],
  .hs-form input[type="email"],
  .hs-form input[type="tel"],
  .hs-form textarea,
  .hs-form select {
    width: 100% !important; background: white !important;
    border: 1px solid #c0cdd6 !important; border-radius: 4px !important;
    padding: 12px 14px !important; font-size: 15px !important;
    color: #012638 !important; margin-bottom: 20px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important; text-align: left !important;
  }
  .hs-form input:focus, .hs-form textarea:focus {
    outline: none !important; border-color: #6BA644 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(107,166,68,.15) !important;
  }
  .hs-form textarea { min-height: 100px !important; }
  .hs-form input[type="submit"], .hs-form .hs-button {
    background: #6BA644 !important; color: white !important;
    border: none !important; border-radius: 4px !important;
    padding: 16px 40px !important; font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: bold !important; letter-spacing: .5px !important;
    cursor: pointer !important; display: block !important;
    width: 100% !important; margin-top: 8px !important;
  }
  .hs-form input[type="submit"]:hover, .hs-form .hs-button:hover { background: #5a9038 !important; }
  .hs-form .hs-error-msgs { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
  .hs-form .hs-error-msgs li { color: #c0392b; font-size: 12px; margin-top: -14px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .hs-form-private .form-title, .hbspt-form .form-title,
  .hs_cos_wrapper_type_form .form-title {
    color: #012638 !important; font-size: 22px !important;
    font-weight: bold !important; text-align: center !important;
    display: block !important; margin-bottom: 24px !important;
  }
</style>
<!-- DVL-PL-FORM:END -->
<!-- DVL-PL-CAT:START -->
<style>
  /* Force all category tile images to uniform height */
  img[src*="WOMENS-CATEGORY-PREXERA"],
  img[src*="PREXERA-MENS"],
  img[src*="prexera-probiotic"],
  img[src*="sleep-prexera"],
  img[src*="prexera-fitness"],
  img[src*="prexera-weight"],
  img[src*="cognitive-prexera"] {
    height: 180px !important;
    max-height: 180px !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    object-fit: cover !important;
    object-position: center !important;
    display: block !important;
  }
  /* Also constrain the card container so it doesn't stretch */
  .hs-image-widget img,
  .cell-wrapper img[src*="pettechlabs"] {
    height: 180px !important;
    max-height: 180px !important;
    object-fit: cover !important;
  }
</style>
<!-- DVL-PL-CAT:END -->
<!-- QBS-SCHEMA:START -->
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","@id":"https://www.praxerasupplements.com/herbal#faq","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What does private labeling herbal supplements actually involve?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Private labeling means you launch a herbal product under your own brand using one of our pre-existing, doctor-formulated stock formulas. We handle production, quality testing, and bottling. You select the formulation from our catalog, design your label, and we produce the finished product ready to ship under your brand. No formulation work, no setup fees, no lab build-out."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What are typical minimums and lead times for herbal products?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Most herbal formulations have minimum order quantities in the low hundreds of bottles per SKU. Once your labels are approved, production typically takes three to four weeks before your first inventory ships. Custom packaging or formulation can extend that timeline. We give you exact MOQs and lead times for the SKUs you select during your consultation."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Are these herbal products FDA-compliant?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. All our herbal formulations are produced in our FDA-registered, GMP-certified Vermont facility. Our formulations meet dietary supplement labeling requirements under DSHEA. Each batch is tested for identity, potency, and contaminants. You receive Certificates of Analysis with your inventory. We help you understand the structure-function claims you can responsibly make on your label."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How much does it cost to launch a herbal private label line?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Total launch cost depends on the SKUs you choose, the packaging you select, and the volume you order. Most clients launch a 3-5 SKU herbal line for under $15,000 in initial inventory, including custom label design. There are no setup fees, no annual contracts, and no formulation costs for private label. We provide transparent SKU-by-SKU pricing during your consultation."}}]}]}</script>
<!-- QBS-SCHEMA:END -->
